g.text: Fresh processes; medians with Q1-Q3. Fixed historical snapshots. Adapter, codec, copies and checksums included.
Shared Xeon host; CPU/NUMA binding; no CPU reservation or frequency lock. No disk I/O. Cohorts with different key counts stay separate.
